protocol.name: v7-t4-feedback-cut-v1
protocol.cut_rule: zero T4a-d source edges into Mi9/Tm3/Mi1/Mi4/C3, or every T4a-d output
protocol.normalization: same uncut calibration; remaining adjacency weights unchanged
protocol.population_ranking: diagnostic, not used to select cuts

limitations: All-output cuts also remove feedforward signalling; stability is not task competence.
One constant background and one initial state do not establish general stability.
Direct cuts test only one-hop T4 inputs; indirect feedback can remain.
Removing edges is an explicit causal ablation, not an improved biological model.
No motion battery, driving release, or biological oscillation claim is made.
